connectionSpecification.description: Reads daily Google Analytics 4 reports, built-in and custom, through the Google Analytics Data API.

credentials.description: A service account key, or an OAuth client with the refresh token of a Google user. Either needs the Viewer role on every property.

service_account_key.description: The JSON key of a service account of a Google Cloud project with the Google Analytics Data API enabled.
service_account_key.title: Service Account Key

client_id.description: Client ID of the Google Cloud OAuth client the refresh token was issued to.
client_id.title: OAuth Client ID

client_secret.description: Client secret of the OAuth client.
client_secret.title: OAuth Client Secret

refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token with the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/analytics.readonly scope.
refresh_token.title: Refresh Token

credentials.title: Authentication

custom_reports.description: Each report becomes a stream with its name, read by day. date is added as the first dimension when missing; at most 9 dimensions with date and 1 to 10 metrics.
custom_reports.title: Custom Reports

data_quality_fields.description: Add sampled, sampling_ratio, subject_to_thresholding and data_loss_from_other_row to every record.
data_quality_fields.title: Data Quality Fields

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, whose reports are read; empty reads up to today (UTC).
end_date.title: End Date

lookback_days.description: Days before the saved date an incremental read starts again, since Google Analytics keeps processing recent days.
lookback_days.title: Lookback Days

property_ids.description: Google Analytics 4 property ids to read, with or without the properties/ prefix. Every report reads each of them.
property_ids.title: Property IDs

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, whose reports are read.
start_date.title: Start Date

connectionSpecification.title: Google Analytics 4 Source Spec
